court: The European Court of Human Rights (Second Section)

anchor.surface_text:
FOR THESE REASONS, THE COURT UNANIMOUSLY

1.  Declares the application admissible;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found the application was not manifestly ill-founded and met admissibility criteria under Article 35 § 3.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been a violation of Article 2 of the Convention in respect of the killing of the first applicant's husband Murat Bektaş

anchor.surface_text: 2.  Holds that there has been a violation of Article 2 of the Convention in respect of the killing of the first applicant's husband Murat Bektaş;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court relied on the domestic court's finding that police officers exceeded their powers causing unlawful death, and that the lenient sentences undermined deterrence, thus violating Article 2.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been a violation of Article 2 of the Convention in respect of the killing of the second applicant's brother Erdinç Arslan

anchor.surface_text: 3.  Holds that there has been a violation of Article 2 of the Convention in respect of the killing of the second applicant's brother Erdinç Arslan;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found that the Government failed to prove the use of lethal force was absolutely necessary due to poor planning and investigative deficiencies, breaching Article 2.

holdings.text: Holds that the respondent State is to pay the applicants, within three months from the date on which the judgment becomes final in accordance with Article 44 § 2 of the Convention, the following amounts, to be converted into Turkish liras at the rate applicable at the date of settlement: (i) to the first applicant, Mrs Kezban Bektaş, EUR 2,800 in respect of pecuniary damage and EUR 60,000 in respect of non-pecuniary damage; (ii) to the second applicant, Ms Gülay Özalp, EUR 200 in respect of pecuniary damage and EUR 40,000 in respect of non-pecuniary damage; (iii) to the two applicants jointly, EUR 1,500 in respect of costs and expenses; and that from the expiry of the above-mentioned three months until settlement simple interest shall be payable on the above amounts at a rate equal to the marginal lending rate of the European Central Bank during the default period plus three percentage points
holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court awarded pecuniary and non-pecuniary damages and costs based on established violations and applicants' claims, applying Article 41 principles.

holdings.text: Dismisses the remainder of the applicants' claim for just satisfaction

anchor.surface_text: 5.  Dismisses the remainder of the applicants' claim for just satisfaction.

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court rejected claims beyond the awarded damages and costs as unsubstantiated or excessive.

outcome.relief_summary: The Court found violations of Article 2 in respect of both applicants' relatives' killings and awarded pecuniary and non-pecuniary damages: EUR 2,800 and EUR 60,000 to the first applicant, EUR 200 and EUR 40,000 to the second applicant, plus EUR 1,500 jointly for costs and expenses. Interest is payable on these amounts from the expiry of three months until settlement. The remainder of the claim for just satisfaction was dismissed.
directions: Respondent State to pay specified sums within three months from the date the judgment becomes final.
Simple interest payable on awarded amounts from expiry of three months until settlement at ECB marginal lending rate plus three percentage points.

3.  Holds that there has been a violation of Article 2 of the Convention in respect of the killing of the second applicant's brother Erdinç Arslan;
5.  Dismisses the remainder of the applicants' claim for just satisfaction.
